snippet.title: Wega And The Lost Media -  Demo 1 Release Trailer (V0.1.0)
snippet.description:
ITS OUT ITS OUT ITS OUT ITS OUTTTTTTTTT

DOWNLOAD IT HERE!!!!!!!! https://team-lost-media.github.io/

(direct download link if website is bugged: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ScYo0YJ9soCkygOWvUkYLdBNhDmVhUh5/view?usp=sharing)

Wega And The Lost Media is an in development shitpost 2D Platformer that follows the iconic Luigi and Mario recolors Wega and Urio, and their quest to stop the evil Maltigi from making their world LOST MEDIA!
The full game will contain 8 worlds of content, 4 weapons for you to break out of bounds with, a soundtrack that's probably better than this game deserves, and shoe bench.
The demo contains the first world and the first weapon! Download Now!

(note: this trailer was made about a week before we actually finished the demo. some things may not be accurate to the actual game! enjoy the surprises and changes!)
